name: alexstocker/owncloud-docker-development
description: Owncloud docker development environment for custom web apps

link-sensorlogger: if [ ! -e "sensorlogger" ]; then ln -s vendor/alexstocker/sensorlogger sensorlogger; fi
link-3dviewer: if [ ! -e "files_3dviewer" ]; then ln -s vendor/alexstocker/3dviewer-for-owncloud files_3dviewer; fi
link-contacts: if [ ! -e "contacts" ]; then ln -s vendor/owncloud/contacts contacts; fi
link-calendar: if [ ! -e "calendar" ]; then ln -s vendor/owncloud/calendar calendar; fi
cleanup: docker volume rm owncloud-docker-development_redis owncloud-docker-development_backup owncloud-docker-development_mysql --force
xdebug-install: docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'apt-get update -y'
docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'apt-get upgrade -y'
docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'apt-get install -y mc iputils-ping php8.3-xdebug'

docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'echo "xdebug.remote_enable=1" >> /etc/php/8.3/apache2/conf.d/20-xdebug.ini && echo "xdebug.remote_autostart=1" >> /etc/php/8.3/apache2/conf.d/20-xdebug.ini && echo "xdebug.remote_port=9003" >> /etc/php/8.3/apache2/conf.d/20-xdebug.ini && echo "xdebug.remote_connect_back=1" >> /etc/php/8.3/apache2/conf.d/20-xdebug.ini'
enable-apps: docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'cat /mnt/data/config/overwrite.config.php'
docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'runuser -u www-data ./occ app:enable sensorlogger'
docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'runuser -u www-data ./occ app:enable files_3dviewer'
docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'runuser -u www-data ./occ app:enable domain_manager'
docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'runuser -u www-data ./occ app:enable contacts'
docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'runuser -u www-data ./occ app:enable calendar'
docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'runuser -u www-data ./occ app:enable rainloop'
docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'runuser -u www-data ./occ app:enable passman'
docker exec -tu root owncloud_server entrypoint bash -c 'runuser -u www-data ./occ app:enable tasks'
